name: Benjamin
summary: Jacob's youngest son, born as his mother Rachel died. He was Joseph's brother by the same mother, and Joseph wept when he saw him again in Egypt.

key_moments.title: Born as Rachel Died
key_moments.description: On the road to Ephrath, Rachel died giving birth to him. With her last breath she named him Ben-oni, but his father called him Benjamin.

key_moments.title: Given Five Times as Much
key_moments.description: In Egypt, Joseph saw Benjamin and blessed him, then slipped away to weep. At the meal, Benjamin was served five times more than any of his brothers.

key_moments.title: Found with Joseph's Silver Cup
key_moments.description: Joseph had his silver cup hidden in Benjamin's sack. When the cup was found there, the brothers tore their clothes and went back to the city.

key_moments.title: Embraced by Joseph
key_moments.description: After Joseph told his brothers who he was, he hugged his brother Benjamin and wept, and Benjamin wept with him.
